matsya-avatar-1-to-5.title: मत्स्यावतार
matsya-avatar-1-to-5.description: Vishnu Bhagwan ke dashavataron mein se Matsya Avatar unka pehla avatar maana jaata hai. Jeevan ke har sankat se shrishti ko bachane ke liye, Bhagwan Vishnu ne kayi baar alag-alag roop dharan kiye hain. Aaj hum baat karenge Matsya Avatar ki, jismein Vishnu Bhagwan ne apne divya roop aur adbhut leela se Haigreeva jaise bade sankat se dharti ko mukt karaya. Chaliye, sunte hain is anokhi kahani ko, jismein Shree Hari ne swayam shrishti ke palanhar ke roop mein avtaran liya aur duniya ko ek naye sankat se bachaya.

unforgivable-1.title: ছোটলোক হাসব্যান্ড
unforgivable-1.description: The drama follows a long chain of betrayals inside marriages, families, and workplaces, with mothers and wives repeatedly forced to fight for children, money, and dignity. It begins with a child’s medical emergency that exposes a husband’s refusal to help and a household that treats the child’s suffering as leverage. The wife is pushed further into despair by a mother-in-law who shames her for not producing a male heir and withholds support. As the pressure grows, private cruelty is overheard, and the betrayed women begin turning grief into revenge. The story then widens into workplace conflict, where romantic rivals, public humiliation, and corporate sabotage become another arena for the same power struggles. Several schemes are exposed as staged or manipulated, including fake affection, image swaps, and public disgrace designed to control reputations. Lalit emerges as a repeated source of betrayal, using lies, humiliation, and financial control to dominate the women around him. Moumita’s fight becomes especially central as she faces disgrace, custody conflict, and the loss of assets while trying to protect her child. Family members on the paternal side repeatedly use the child as a weapon, including taking the child away, denying medicine, and escalating the conflict into public outrage. The domestic war spills into legal battles over divorce, custody, property, and control of the home. Lawyers and allies become important as some characters try to recover stolen assets or delay divorce long enough to expose fraud. Financial manipulation grows more severe, with property deals, hidden debts, and illegal house schemes threatening to ruin multiple families. In parallel, several men pursue wealth through romance or marriage, only to be exposed by sharper women who refuse to stay silent. Public shame becomes a recurring tactic, but it often backfires and reveals the deception underneath. The stakes rise further when Moumita is critically injured in a car crash and the fight shifts to who has the right to make medical decisions for her. Even in that vulnerable state, she is not safe, because others appear ready to exploit her condition for money or control. Across the later arc, hidden motives are uncovered, revenge plots collapse, and alliances form among betrayed women and their supporters. By the end of the batch digests, the show has become a high-stakes battle over survival, truth, and who gets to claim family, love, and property.
